name: Ahithophel
role: David's counsellor who went over to Absalom
whenBasis: In David's reign, ≈1010–970 BC, counted back from Solomon as Thiele and most chronologies do.
summary: A Gilonite whose advice was regarded like the word of God, counsellor to David and then to Absalom. He told Absalom to go in to his father's concubines, and urged an immediate attack with twelve thousand men to kill David alone. When Absalom took Hushai's advice instead, Ahithophel saddled his donkey, went home, put his affairs in order and hanged himself.
body: When David hears he has joined the conspiracy, he prays, “O LORD, please turn the counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness!”, and sends Hushai back to defeat it. His plan was sound; the LORD had ordained that it be frustrated.
He is the father of Eliam, one of David's mighty men, and some take him to be Bathsheba's grandfather, since she is Eliam's daughter.
